connection.instructions:
Connect directly with your own MyGeotab login -- no OAuth popup, no separate developer account. Enter your MyGeotab database name, username, and password (or a Geotab API key in the password field; MyGeotab authenticates both the same way).

1. Find your **database name** in your MyGeotab sign-in URL -- if you sign in at `my.geotab.com/<database>`, the `<database>` part is what you enter below.
2. Enter the **username** (email address) you use to sign in to MyGeotab.
3. Enter your MyGeotab **password**, or a Geotab API key if your organisation issues those instead -- MyGeotab accepts either in the password field.

Your credentials are sent directly to your connected MyGeotab database on every request; they are never stored by mySMB beyond this connection.

description: Connect Geotab fleet telematics directly against MyGeotab's classic REST/JSON-RPC API using your own database, username, and password -- no OAuth, no developer account. A self-hosted alternative to the official Geotab-hosted MCP connector for platforms it doesn't support yet. Vehicle location, live geofence on-site/in-transit/offline status, trips, mileage/fuel usage, and fleet reporting.
name: geotab-direct
